listen_addr.description: Address and port the remctl server should bind to. Use 'host:port' or just 'port' for all interfaces.

keytab_path.description: Path to the Kerberos keytab file used for authentication.

service_name.description: Kerberos service name (e.g., 'host' or 'remctl') to use in SPNEGO negotiation.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to stderr.

root_dir.description: Optional chroot directory (absolute path). If empty, no chroot is performed.

maxconn.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections. Set to 0 for unlimited.

acls.description: List of ACL entries granting Kerberos principals permission to run specific commands.

commands.description: List of command names (or '*' for all) this principal may execute.
